200 Southridge Dr, Okotoks, AB T1S 0B2, Canadá
Westmount Rd, Okotoks
fields.Notes:
1. A full road closure on Westmount Rd (Plan A) will not be permitted, as this route provides the only access to the commercial businesses located south of the proposed closure.

• SEE PLAN B (Revised Phase 2) which maintains two-way traffic on Westmount Rd to ensure continuous access to commercial businesses.

2. Plan B is preferred; however, it will require revisions. Currently, signage on Southridge Dr. is unclear, with conflicting instructions (e.g., no right turn followed immediately by a straight/right turn indication).

•R// This is not a "No Right Turn" sign; the sign represents a NO TURN ON RED. This allows vehicles to proceed straight and to turn right, however, they cannot turn on RED because the dedicated turning lane has been closed for the work zone.

3. Traffic traveling westbound from the east does not appear to have adequate advance warning or directional guidance.

•R// The plan has been updated to include additional advance warning signage for westbound traffic. Variable Message Signs (VMS) have been strategically positioned in advance of the intersection to provide clear directional guidance and adequate reaction time, in accordance with the Temporary Traffic Control Manual standards.

4. Similarly, northbound traffic intending to turn left is not clearly addressed.

•R// The revised plan incorporates specific lane designation signage and clear detour routing for northbound traffic intending to turn left. Additional delineation and traffic control devices have been added to guide these vehicles safely through the modified intersection layout.

5. Variable Message Boards (VMS) may be required to help manage potentially confusing movements, particularly:

•For southbound traffic on Westmount Rd approaching the closure, where access to commercial properties remains available immediately prior to the closure.

•For traffic traveling south on Southridge Dr., turning west onto Westland St, and then south onto Westmount Rd.

•R// VMS boards have been added to the revised plan to address both specific movements. A VMS is now positioned for southbound Westmount Rd traffic to clearly indicate "LOCAL ACCESS ONLY" while notifying through-traffic of the closure ahead. An additional VMS has been placed to guide the southbound Southridge Dr. detour route via Westland St.

6. No pedestrian accommodation or detour information has been provided. This must be clearly identified if pedestrian routes are impacted.

•R// The revised plan (Phase 2) explicitly notes "NO PEDESTRIAN IMPACT" in the affected areas. Existing pedestrian pathways and crosswalks will remain open and accessible throughout the duration of the utility tie-in work. Should any temporary sidewalk closures become necessary during specific operations, standard pedestrian detour signage (TC-40 series) will be implemented.

7. The south road closure plan should also be reviewed to ensure similar scenarios are addressed.

•R// The south road closure plan has been thoroughly reviewed and updated in parallel with these revisions. Similar advance warning, clear directional signage, and VMS deployments have been incorporated to ensure consistency and address all potential traffic movement conflicts across the entire project scope.
